scope: First-pass PowerSimulationsDynamics.jl component-test comparison focused on transmission-dynamics machines and IBRs.

status_legend.compare-limited: HACDCPF has a current model and an existing or near-existing trace hook, but it does not cover PSD's full residual/mass-matrix/small-signal test contract.
status_legend.full-gate: HACDCPF has an executable PSD ResidualModel/IDA vs HACDCPF MassMatrixDae gate for the declared traces; internal DAE-object parity is included where declared.
status_legend.compare-failing: HACDCPF has a current model and trace hook, but the current PSD comparison gate fails and must be treated as a stop/go blocker.
status_legend.blocked-missing-model: The PSD test's primary model is not implemented in the HACDCPF transient runtime.
status_legend.blocked-missing-controller: The base machine or IBR may exist, but a required PSD controller/block is not implemented.
status_legend.blocked-missing-formulation: The dynamic behavior may be partially present, but HACDCPF does not yet expose PSD-equivalent residual/mass-matrix/small-signal parity.
status_legend.metadata-only: The model identity can be preserved for IO, but behavior should not be compared yet.

execution_manifest.description: Opt-in executable PSD comparison gates consumed by tests/test_transient_dynamics.cpp. Cases remain narrow while HACDCPF grows PSD-equivalent residual-vector, mass-matrix, Jacobian, and small-signal APIs.
